title: Program Director, New Site Development - Data Centers, APAC
location_raw: Melbourne, Australia; Sydney, Australia; Singapore, Singapore; Tokyo, Japan
description:
About Vantage

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.
Position Description

The Program Director is accountable for leading the front-end development lifecycle of new data center opportunities across APAC, progressing projects from initial site identification through land acquisition and execution readiness. Acting as the central coordinator across internal and external stakeholders, this role drives due diligence, investment decision-making, and governance processes to maximize site conversion and ensure development opportunities align with Vantage's strategic growth objectives.

The Program Director will oversee cross-functional due diligence programs spanning site evaluation, technical and infrastructure assessments, commercial analysis, and risk management. A key responsibility will be leading governance frameworks, stage-gate processes, and investment approval pathways to ensure opportunities meet defined criteria before advancing. The role will provide transparency across the APAC project pipeline, develop robust business cases, and lead the preparation and presentation of investment recommendations to the APAC Investment Council and other executive decision-making forums.

Success in this role requires strong collaboration across Leadership, Site Selection, Design & Engineering, Construction, Operations, Finance, Sales, Marketing, and other subject matter experts. Acting as a key integrator, the Program Director will align technical, commercial, operational, and strategic priorities, drive decision-making through effective governance, and ensure Vantage has the right capacity in the right markets at the right time to support customer demand and long-term growth across the APAC region.

Essential Job Functions

- Lead the APAC Investment Council, driving strategic investment decisions, prioritization of development opportunities and portfolio growth initiatives across the region.

- Lead and manage all aspects of technical and commercial due diligence and front-end planning for new development projects, including site assessments, feasibility studies, conceptual design, due diligence workstreams, power and fibre strategy development, entitlement, and permitting activities.

- Provide strategic leadership, thought partnership, and executive-level guidance on key projects and initiatives, including budget management, schedule oversight, risk mitigation, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.

- Drive cross-functional alignment between development, investment, operations, legal, finance, and commercial teams to ensure successful project execution and achievement of regional growth objectives.

- Lead the definition and execution of due diligence programs for complex infrastructure development opportunities, ensuring key technical, commercial, regulatory, and delivery risks are identified, appropriately investigated, and assessed to support investment, acquisition, and development decision-making.

Duties

- Lead the APAC Investment Council process, providing transparency across the regional development pipeline, developing robust business cases, and preparing and presenting investment recommendations to executive leadership and decision-making forums.

- Serve as the primary owner of front-end development activities, driving opportunities from site identification through land acquisition by coordinating due diligence, risk management, stakeholder alignment, and investment approvals to improve conversion of site selection opportunities.

- Lead all early-stage project development and due diligence activities, including site selection, feasibility assessments, conceptual design, utility strategy (power, water, and fiber), permitting pathways, commercial assessments, risk evaluations, and investment approval processes.

- I nte rpret technical f indin gs an d provide development and c ommercial re commendatio ns and risk mitig ation strategi es to support a cquisitio ns .

- Act as the central point of integration across internal and external stakeholders undertaking due diligence , ensuring alignment, accountability, and timely decision-making throughout the development lifecycle.

- Provide executive oversight and portfolio governance across the APAC development pipeline, delivering regular updates to Executive Leadership on project progress, risks, schedules, budgets, quality, financial performance, cash flow, and critical decisions required to achieve business objectives.

- Drive cross-functional collaboration across Site Selection, Development, Operations, Finance, Legal, Commercial, Procurement, Design , Engineering and Construction, and Executive Leadership teams to define project requirements, resolve issues, manage risks, and support informed investment decisions.

- Lead and manage relationships with external consultants, landowners, contractors, utilities, government authorities, regulatory agencies, and industry stakeholders to secure successful project outcomes and maintain development momentum.

- Drive project outcomes from concept through execution readiness, establishing scope, schedule, budget, governance frameworks, consultant engagement strategies, and business case approvals while maintaining alignment with strategic objectives and investment criteria.

- Oversee portfolio reporting and governance, ensuring leadership maintains full visibility of pipeline health, site conversion performance, project risks, costs, schedules, market dynamics, and capital deployment priorities.

- Identify and mitigate development, permitting, commercial, infrastructure, and execution risks to support successful project advancement and informed investment decisions.

- Lead contract governance, performance reporting, and financial management activities, ensuring robust controls, risk management, and informed decision-making across the portfolio.

- Champion continuous improvement by incorporating lessons learned, market intelligence, industry trends, and best practices to enhance development processes, strengthen governance, and support Vantage's long-term growth strategy across APAC.

Skills, Knowledge and Experience

- Proven experience managing complex development, infrastructure, construction, or real estate projects, ideally in a client-side environment.

- Ability to manage multiple stakeho lders and compet ing priorities, work independently, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.

- Experience across APAC markets, particularly Singapore, Malaysia, Japan, and Australia, is highly desirable.

- Strong understanding of site acquisition, due diligence, planning, permitting, and utility infrastructure (power and fibre).

- Exceptional stakeholder management, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills.

- Demonstrated success leading cross-functional teams and influencing senior leaders and external partners.

- Degree in Engineering, Construction, Real Estate, Business, or a related field preferred.

- Flexibility to travel regularly across APAC.

- Adaptable, self-motivated, and comfortable working across multiple time zones, cultures, and remote environments.

title: Business Analyst, Budget Planning & Financial Operations, Global
description:
About Vantage

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

About Vantage Data Centers
Vantage Data Centers powers, cools, protects, and connects the technology of the world's well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across 19 markets in North America, EMEA and APAC, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands. Vantage's business is growing exponentially, through a combination of greenfield market expansion and acquisitions.

Business Optimization & Vendor Management Department
The Business Optimization & Vendor Management team supports effective planning, financial visibility, operational discipline, and informed decision-making. The team partners with budget owners, business leaders, Finance, Procurement, and other stakeholders to maintain reliable planning information, monitor financial commitments, improve reporting, and strengthen processes that help the organization use its resources effectively.

Position Overview
The Business Analyst, Budget Planning & Financial Operations supports budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and analysis activities that help business leaders effectively manage approved budgets and financial commitments throughout the year.
This role partners with budget owners and business leaders to maintain accurate forecasts, monitor spending, identify risks and opportunities, and keep assumptions aligned with current business needs. The analyst helps stakeholders avoid unexpected overspend while also identifying available funding and planned activities that may need action so approved resources are used effectively.
The ideal candidate is analytical, highly organized, and comfortable working directly with stakeholders. As the individual develops knowledge of the business and its planning processes, they will take an increasingly active role in recurring forecast discussions, budget reviews, and follow-up with assigned budget owners.

Essential Job Functions

Budget Planning & Forecast Management

- Support annual budget planning and recurring forecast cycles, including non-labor operating expense and capital expenditure planning.

- Maintain and update forecast workbooks, planning files, assumptions, and supporting documentation throughout the year.

- Work with budget owners to understand spending plans, project timing, contract obligations, purchase commitments, and changing business priorities.

- Help budget owners maintain realistic forecasts that reduce the risk of overspending and highlight opportunities to use approved funding before year-end.

- Track forecast changes, open actions, and decisions to ensure planning information remains current and explainable.

- Identify potential overages, unused funding, timing shifts, and other risks or opportunities, and raise them for timely discussion and action.

- Support capital planning, project cost tracking, and workforce or position planning activities as assigned.

Budget Owner & Business Leader Partnership

- Build productive working relationships with budget owners and business leaders.

- Prepare for and participate in recurring budget and forecast review meetings.

- Ask thoughtful questions, clarify assumptions, document decisions, and follow up on required updates.

- Explain budget, forecast, actual, and committed-spend information in clear business terms.

- Provide budget owners with timely information that supports prioritization and spending decisions.

- With appropriate training and experience, independently lead routine forecast conversations and serve as a primary point of contact for assigned budget owners.

- Coordinate with Finance and other stakeholders to resolve discrepancies and keep planning data aligned.

Financial Analysis & Reporting

- Analyze budget, forecast, actual, committed, and planned spend information.

- Perform variance analysis and identify the operational drivers behind changes in financial performance.

- Review spending trends and summarize relevant risks, opportunities, and recommended follow-up actions.

- Prepare recurring reports, dashboards, meeting materials, and concise leadership summaries.

- Support ad hoc analysis, project financial reviews, business cases, and return-on-investment analysis as needed.

- Contribute to budget planning scenarios and longer-range analysis using documented assumptions.

Data Management, Controls & Process Improvement

- Reconcile financial and operational information across systems, reports, and source files.

- Validate data, investigate discrepancies, and document assumptions, methods, and exceptions.

- Maintain accurate, audit-ready records of forecast updates, commitments, decisions, and supporting information.

- Create and maintain reports, dashboards, process documentation, and user guidance.

- Identify practical improvements that increase forecast accuracy, strengthen controls, and reduce manual effort.

- Support small-scale reporting, process, or tool improvement initiatives.

- Handle additional duties as assigned by management.

Job Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Analytics,or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

- Approximately 2 to 5 years of experience in business analysis, budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, operations, project controls, portfolio administration, or a related role.

- Experience supporting budget planning, forecast maintenance, financial reporting, or variance analysis.

- Working knowledge of operating expense and capital expenditure concepts.

- Strong Microsoft Excel skills and comfort working with detailed financial and operational data.

- Ability to organize information, manage multiple priorities, and follow through on open actions.

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, written, and verbal communication skills.

- Ability to build trusted relationships and communicate financial information to non-financial stakeholders.

- Attention to detail and commitment to data quality, documentation, and confidentiality.

- Ability to work collaboratively across teams and adapt to changing priorities.

Preferred Experience

- Budget owner or business-partner support.

- Non-labor forecast management, project portfolio support, or contract and vendor spend analysis.

- Capital planning, project cost tracking, or multi-year planning.

- Executive-ready reporting, dashboards, KPI reporting, or data visualization.

- Experience with Power BI, Workday, ERP or financial planning systems, procurement systems, or similar business tools.

- Process improvement, requirements gathering, or small-scale project coordination.

title: Development Strategy Manager, NA

description:
About Vantage

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.
Position Overview

This role can be based in any of our US locations: Denver, CO; Phoenix, AZ; Quincy, WA; Santa Clara, CA; or Ashburn, VA. Following our flexible work policy (3 days in-office and 2 days flexible).

The Development Strategy Manager supports the integrated development planning function across North America by translating market intelligence, customer demand signals, portfolio priorities, infrastructure constraints, regulatory considerations, commercial requirements, and funnel development activity into clear, decision-ready recommendations. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Development Strategy, this role helps maintain portfolio visibility, support site and market prioritization, evaluate customer-led and proactive opportunities, manage recurring development reporting, and produce analyses and materials that guide capital allocation, leasable inventory creation, customer engagement, and executive decision-making.

Essential Job Functions
Business Development Enablement:

- Partner with marketing, sales, product, design, and operations teams to support prospecting, customer diversification efforts, and enterprise engagement initiatives.

- Support the development of high-quality marketing materials, site briefs, and executive-level presentations aligned to a One Vantage approach.

- Contribute to the commercial narrative and positioning of potential opportunities, ensuring alignment between customer requirements and Vantage's strategic and operational capabilities.

Market, Customer & Commercial Strategy:

- Integrate customer leasing intelligence, workload segmentation, sales inputs, and market demand signals into market prioritization and site-level strategy.

- Triage customer-led and proactive opportunities; shape asset positioning including size, phasing, power, schedule, customer fit, and leasing strategy.

- Produce customer materials, portfolio fit assessments, and market narratives that credibly position sites against customer requirements and timelines.

Executive Reporting, Governance & Decision Support:

- Support Market Development inputs for Board materials, Monthly Business Reviews, executive leadership updates, NALT discussions, investor materials, customer inventory requests, and recurring development reporting.

- Enable structured decision-making through portfolio reviews, funnel reviews, monthly strategy meetings, and other governance forums by preparing clear agendas, analysis, recommendations, and follow-up materials.

Analytics, TCO Modeling & KPI Integrity:

- Update and maintain site comparison analyses, total cost of ownership models, portfolio dashboards, market opportunity trackers, land budget support materials, and other source-of-truth datasets.

- Support scenario planning, funnel conversion analysis, inventory coverage analysis, leasing target analysis, and market-level comparative assessments.

Process & Systems Optimization:

- Exposure to technology, data centers, telecommunications, infrastructure, financial services, real estate, or other capital-intensive industries.

title: Procurement Analyst, NA
description:
About Vantage

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

Position Description
Vantage is looking for a self-starter in the role of the Procurement Analyst to be part of a team that manages OFCI Equipment, which is the second largest individual cost within the construction process. The candidate will become engaged in the supply chain aspects of our Data Centers In this role, you will be responsible for record keeping, assist in obtaining updated vendors submittals; maintaining product specifications; working with vendors, and with the Procurement team to ensure specifications are adhered to in accordance with our company processes.  The candidate will monitor and manage contracts, prepare status and tracking reports for the company, and support the Procurement Managers and Director in their daily tasks. Regular collaboration and coordination are required with our supply chain partners and internal teams such as Engineering and Operations, as well as multiple Construction Management Teams. Travel will be necessary to various factories for factory witness testing, audits, and on-boarding of new vendors. Minimal travel to Vantage Data Center sites may also be required occasionally.

Responsibilities

- The individual will be working with the procurement team daily to provide needed assistance ensuring the department meets and exceeds its goals within the company.

- Individual will be a self-starter with the ability to manage and assist in the review of single line diagrams, product specifications, and drive OFCI Equipment submittals to closure (approval).

- Successful candidates will understand RFIs and RFQs for sourcing low voltage switchgear, medium voltage switchgear, transformers, electrical skids, CRAH’s, chillers, generators, UPSs and other data center equipment systems as needed.

- Individuals will be expected to independently coordinate with OFCI equipment vendors on continuous quality improvement, leading quality control and lessons learned implementation efforts.

- Manage and track equipment status with the vendors such that all scheduled dates set by the construction schedules are met.

- Assist in analyzing vendors’ quotes, change order requests, and submittals.

- Optimizing costs while maintaining quality/reliability of the equipment and vendor services.

- Utilize financial software to enter PO’s, review invoices, track budgets, and allocate equipment from purchase to the projects.

- Support the Procurement Inventory program to update equipment availability.

- Support Procurement Managers and Finance / Accounting with project financial closeout and invoice resolution.

- Drive project-level tasks and milestones assigned by the Construction Project Management team.

- Coordinate with vendors for scheduling start-up and commissioning support services.

- Maintain and develop supplier relationships.

- Work with members of the procurement team to contribute to ongoing process improvement efforts aimed at increasing efficiency and accuracy.

- Work with Compliance and Vendor Onboarding teams to ensure vendors are within established guidelines.

- Work with operations and reliability engineering personnel of the Vantage buildings to ensure the proper spare parts and service programs are properly in place and assist with their database.

- Support Construction Project Management and Environmental Health & Safety teams to ensure that OFCI vendors comply with all safety requirements.

Duties

- Collaborate with various stakeholders to ensure clarity of the equipment specifications and operational requirements.

- Work with Finance, Accounting,  and Construction Project Management teams to ensure all purchases have appropriately been costed to a project.

- Help coordinate the approval and onsite delivery of the necessary equipment per the construction schedule.

- Support Design Engineering in investigating new products and new vendors.

- Communicate openly and transparently with   Construction Project Management teams for delivery success.

- Assist in the management and support of equipment inventory planning efforts to include negotiation, purchase order issuance, and forecasting.

Job Requirements

- Bachelor of Science in engineering, construction science, supply chain management, logistics, business administration, or related field or equivalent experience, is required.

- 1 to 3 years of experience in a supply chain and/or construction role is required.

- Data Center, commercial, or industrial equipment experience is strongly preferred.

- Aptitude to learn quickly and drive things to closure is required.

- Strong business acumen with a strong commercial background is required.

- Knowledge of sourcing and procurement techniques is required

title: Sustainability Data Lead, Global
description:
About Vantage

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

Position Overview
Vantage is   seeking   an   Global Sustainability Data Lead to own the design, governance, and continuous evolution of the company's Sustainability data ecosystem. This is a role for a sustainability professional who brings deep   expertise   in environmental metrics, including carbon and water accounting methodologies, and has the technical data skills to translate that   expertise   into scalable, auditable, and repeatable systems.

Vantage’s Sustainability reporting program has grown in scope and complexity, and stakeholder expectations for our sustainability reporting have also increased. This role   is responsible for   building the data architecture, governance framework, and standardized processes that will allow the organization to meet those expectations consistently. The Global Sustainability Data lead will move the company from ad hoc data collection toward a model where sustainability data is well-defined, reliably sourced, and reusable across disclosure cycles. In addition to internal and regulatory reporting, this role   is responsible for   developing customized Sustainability data solutions for customers and investors, including structured data packages,   methodology   documentation, and responses to non-standard or   contractually   required reporting requests.

The role requires substantive expertise in sustainability measurement methodologies, including GHG Protocol Scope 1–3, market-based and location-based Scope 2 accounting, 24/7 carbon-free energy accounting, water use effectiveness, and water accounting standards, combined with hands-on technical proficiency in SQL, Python or R, and BI platforms. Candidates should bring the methodological depth to make sound accounting judgments and the technical capability to operationalize them in scalable systems.

As a member of the Global Sustainability Center of Excellence, this role works closely with sustainability program owners and regional leads, and partners with IT, Investor Relations, Capital Markets, Corporate Development, Customer Experience, and Operations to ensure Sustainability data serves the full range of internal and external needs.

Essential Job Functions & Duties
Sustainability Data Architecture & Ecosystem Ownership

- Design and own the Sustainability data ecosystem, including how metrics are defined, sourced, calculated, validated, stored, and reused across all reporting, disclosure, and program management use cases.

- Establish and maintain a single source of truth for Sustainability metrics and calculation methodologies, with particular depth in GHG Protocol Scope 1, 2, and 3 accounting; market-based vs. location-based Scope 2 methodology selection and application; 24/7 carbon-free energy (CFE) accounting; water use effectiveness (WUE) and power usage effectiveness (PUE) metrics; and water accounting frameworks.

- Design structured, repeatable data flows that replace one-off data pulls to build the Sustainability data infrastructure that the organization and critical stakeholders can rely on as reporting obligations scale.

- Set and enforce standards for Sustainability data quality, definitions, documentation, timing, and traceability across all business units and geographies.

Systems, Platforms & Technical Data Infrastructure

- Own sustainability data and reporting platforms end‑to‑end, including workflow configuration, calculation logic, controls, platform governance, and evaluation of new tools as needs evolve.

- Design and maintain automated sustainability data pipelines using SQL and Python within a Microsoft‑based enterprise data environment (e.g., Azure data services, enterprise data lake/warehouse, Fabric or equivalent), reducing manual data handling and reconciliation.

- Develop curated sustainability datasets and semantic data models that enable consistent outputs across: Power BI dashboards, annual sustainability reporting, regulatory disclosures, and customer and investor data requests.

- Embed data lineage, metadata, audit trails, and explainability directly into sustainability data workflows so reported figures are defensible under third‑party assurance, internal audit, and executive review.

- Partner closely with IT and enterprise data teams to align sustainability data architecture with core data standards, security controls, and platform roadmaps, ensuring sustainability data is integrated into Vantage’s broader data ecosystem.

Customer & Investor Sustainability Data Solutions

- Develop and deliver customized Sustainability data packages and reporting solutions for customers and investors, including structured datasets, supporting methodology documentation, and responses to non-standard or contractually required disclosure requests.

- Serve as the Sustainability data point of contact for customer and investor reporting requests, assessing scope, determining the appropriate methodology, and ensuring outputs meet external quality and accuracy standards.

Data Collection & Reporting Execution

- Lead Sustainability data collection, preparation, validation, and quality assurance for the annual Sustainability Report, ensuring datasets are complete, audit-ready, and consistent with approved methodologies.

- Own the intake, scoping, and fulfillment of Sustainability reporting requests; distinguish between requests that can be addressed with existing data versus those requiring new collection or methodology development.

- Execute sustainability reporting and disclosure requests in partnership with the Sr. Manager, ensuring outputs meet established definitions, methodologies, and quality standards.

- Maintain a comprehensive reporting calendar and curate trusted, reusable datasets that reduce repetitive data work across disclosure cycles.

- Serve as the primary technical contact for third-party assurance providers and internal audit, defending data methodologies, calculation assumptions, and quality controls.

Program Enablement & Cross-Functional Partnership

- Act as the Sustainability data authority for sustainability program owners and regional leads, helping define data requirements for new initiatives and ensuring teams have reliable data to manage performance against targets.

- Train sustainability team members and data owners on how to access, interpret, and contribute to Sustainability data systems.

- Prepare structured Sustainability datasets and supporting materials to enable high-quality internal decision-making and external communications.

- Monitor the regulatory landscape for Sustainability disclosure requirements (e.g., CSRD/ESRS, ISSB, SEC climate rules, California SB 253 and 261) and proactively assess implications for Company's data systems and methodologies.

Job Requirements
Experience

- 7–10 years of experience in Sustainability reporting, sustainability analytics, environmental data management, or a combination of sustainability and data governance roles.

- Demonstrated experience designing or transforming structured Sustainability or environmental data collection and reporting processes in complex, multi-site organizations.

Vantage is seeking a mid-level Database Administrator with experience installing, upgrading, and patching database servers and software across both Windows and Linux environments. This role also includes managing and administering cloud-based database solutions.

The successful candidate will be confident writing queries and developing tables, program views, functions, and stored procedures. Position Overview

This role can be based remotely in the US or in Denver, CO.

The Director, AI Delivery, Global serves as Vantage's execution leader for artificial intelligence delivery, translating approved business requirements into measurable business impact through disciplined delivery of AI solutions. This role owns the Accelerators/Delivery pillar of the AI Organization, accepting validated opportunities from the Navigators pillar, building and testing the solution, and transitioning it to Platform for operational readiness and to Adoption for rollout. The Director builds and leads the AI Delivery team, ensuring that delivery velocity never compromises technical excellence, governance compliance, or sustainable scalability.

This position represents the essential bridge between strategic AI vision and operational reality, accountable for transforming Vantage's ambitious AI roadmap into deployable capabilities that measurably advance business objectives. Essential Job Functions
Key Responsibilities:

- Proven track record establishing delivery methodologies that balance innovation velocity with technical quality, having led teams that consistently delivered validated solutions while maintaining governance compliance and architectural coherence.

Within Operational Excellence, the Data Analytics & Intelligence function enables Operations to move from reactive reporting to proactive, insight-driven execution. The team is responsible for building trusted data foundations, governed KPI frameworks, operational intelligence products, and AI-ready data assets that support performance visibility, decision-making, predictive insights, and scalable operational excellence across North America. This work directly supports Operational Excellence's mission of embedding delivery rigor, process discipline, and data intelligence into how Operations plans, executes, predicts, and continuously improves.

Position Overview
This position will be based on-site at our office in Denver, CO. in alignmen t with our flexible work policy. (3 days on site required, 2 days flexible).

Vantage Data Centers is seeking a Sr Data Engineer to help build, operate, and scale the governed data foundation for Operations, North America. This role is designed for an engineer who can independently deliver production-ready pipelines, curated datasets, semantic-model inputs, and AI-ready data products that support reporting, Executive reporting insight preparation, and the emerging AI Insight Solution.
As part of the Data Engineering & Business Intelligence team, you will be responsible for delivering reliable data products that support analytics, AI data agents, operational intelligence, reporting, and an emerging AI-enabled platform. You will work closely with IT Global, solution build teams, business SMEs, and data governance partners to ensure data products are secure, reusable, explainable, and aligned with enterprise AI / Fabric direction.
Success in this position requires comfort with ambiguity, strong execution discipline, and accountability for building trusted data assets that can be reused across analytics, operational intelligence, and AI-enabled use cases.

Essential Job Functions

- Design, build, and maintain reliable, scalable data pipelines using Python and PySpark on the Microsoft Azure data platform.

- Develop and operate batch and incremental data pipelines leveraging Azure Data Factory for orchestration and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 as the primary data store.

- Build and maintain curated lakehouse / gold-layer datasets and semantic-model inputs that support governed operational insights and AI-enabled consumption.

- Independently implement SQL- and Spark-based transformations to produce curated datasets that support enterprise reporting, analytics, AI-enabled insight preparation, and downstream consumption.

- Take ownership of assigned data pipelines and datasets, including monitoring, troubleshooting, performance optimization, documentation, and production support.

- Work with Azure Synapse, Microsoft Fabric / Lakehouse patterns where applicable, and related Azure analytics services to support analytical workloads and data consumption patterns.

- Prepare structured operational data for AI-enabled use cases by documenting business rules, source lineage, data reliability constraints, known quality limitations, and data dictionary definitions.

- Support source visibility, confidence context, and Data Reliability & Trust Indicator integration where applicable so downstream analytics and AI outputs can be understood and trusted.

- Contribute to ontology, taxonomy, semantic model, and data dictionary alignment needed to connect operational context, KPIs, incidents, work orders, and other enterprise data domains.

- Collaborate with business analysts, operations SMEs, data stewards, IT Global, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate requirements into practical, working data solutions.

- Apply established data governance, security, access-control, data classification, and engineering standards to ensure compliant, maintainable, and scalable solutions.

- Identify, document, and route data-quality issues to accountable owners, helping improve source correction rather than masking defects downstream.

- Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, sprint planning, and platform improvement initiatives as an active contributor.

- Proactively identify data quality issues, pipeline risks, platform dependencies, and improvement opportunities, and communicate them clearly in a fast-paced environment.

Duties

- Develop and maintain PySpark notebooks and jobs to ingest, transform, validate, and curate data within the enterprise data platform.

- Build and modify Azure Data Factory pipelines for batch and incremental data ingestion.

- Implement Spark-based transformations that write curated datasets to Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 and/or Fabric Lakehouse patterns using established folder structures, naming conventions, and governance standards.

- Create and maintain SQL views, tables, lakehouse objects, and semantic-model inputs to support analytics, operational intelligence, and AI-enabled consumption patterns.

- Prepare datasets for Fabric Data Agent / AI agent use cases by documenting business rules, joins, grain, quality limitations, source lineage, and operational definitions.

- Respond to pipeline failures, data validation issues, operational alerts, and data-quality escalations with clear root-cause analysis and practical remediation steps.

- Perform performance tuning of Spark jobs and SQL workloads, including partitioning, filtering, incremental logic, query optimization, and resource-aware design within established architectural patterns.

- Validate data outputs with business partners, operations SMEs, and data stewards, and address defects or discrepancies through documented correction paths.

- Support observability, logging, and auditability practices for data pipelines and AI-consumable datasets where applicable.

- Commit code using Git, follow branching standards, participate in pull request reviews, and support CI/CD ways of working using GitHub, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.

- Update documentation for pipelines, datasets, data contracts, data dictionaries, business rules, and operational runbooks as changes are made.

- Execute assigned backlog items within sprint timelines and raise risks, dependencies, or blockers early.

- Additional duties as assigned by management.

Job Requirements
Education & Experience

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

- Minimum of 5–8 years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a closely related technical data role.

- Proficiency in Python for building and maintaining data pipelines, automation, data processing workflows, and PySpark-based transformations.

- Proficiency in SQL for querying, transformation, analytical data processing, model validation, and data quality checks.

- Solid understanding of ETL/ELT pipelines, data transformation patterns, data integration concepts, incremental processing, and production support practices.

- Experience analyzing enterprise data sources to identify data relationships, transformations, business rules, grain, ownership, and quality constraints.

- Experience building solutions on the Microsoft Azure platform with exposure to Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Microsoft Fabric / Lakehouse patterns, and related analytics services.

- Working knowledge of data modeling fundamentals, including fact and dimension tables, semantic models, reusable data products, and analytics-ready structures.

- Experience supporting governed data products, including metadata, lineage, issue documentation, access-control awareness, data-quality validation, and operational runbooks.

- Experience working with source control and CI/CD workflows using tools such as GitHub or Azure DevOps.

- Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate across IT Global, business SMEs, data governance partners, platform teams, and operations stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.

- Experience working in Agile development environments and using collaboration or project tracking tools such as Jira or similar tools.

Desired Qualifications

- Familiarity with data observability, metadata management, lineage, data contracts, reliability indicators, and operational best practices in production environments.

- Familiarity with additional Azure services such as Azure Functions or Logic Apps in support of data workflows.

title: Senior Manager, Capital Markets, NA
description:
About Vantage Data Centers

Vantage Data Centers powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

Position Description

This role can be based in Denver, CO   in alignment with our flexible work policy ( 3 days in, 2 days flexible).

Vantage is seeking a detail-oriented, analytical, initiative-driven, quick-learning colleague to execute on projects to support the finance organization, including debt capital raising (acquisition financing, construction financing, securitizations), interest rate risk management, and cash forecasting. You will support the VP, Capital Markets directly and interact with the SVP, Capital Markets and Chief Financial Officer (Global), & SVP, Corporate Development and Strategy, and the teams supporting them. The ideal candidate will be an autonomous self-starter who is capable of driving results without constant direction. You should have a professional-growth mindset and be willing to bring forth ideas that can benefit Vantage.

Essential Job Functions

- Debt capital raising initiatives

- Assist in negotiation of term-sheets and prepare recommendation of debt financing solution

- Prepare project information materials for banks through close interaction with finance, new site development, construction & operations teams

- Create, maintain & update flexible, accurate & user-friendly financial models

- Manage due diligence process on capital raising initiatives

- Manage information flow with banks, lawyers and internal constituencies

- Negotiate loan documentation

- Maintain trackers with tasks, responsibilities and due dates

- Ensure smooth hand-over to finance team for funding mechanics, reporting requirements, covenant compliance, etc..

- Coordinate with finance team on any post-closing interactions with the lenders (amendments, waivers, etc)

- Monitor competitors’ debt financing structures and maintain internal database

- Interest rate risk management

- Perform scenario analysis on interest rate volatility impact on covenant compliance

- Prepare cost-benefit analysis of various interest rate hedging mechanisms (swap, cap, swaption) & provide recommendation

- Assist in executing interest rate hedging transactions

- Drive preparation of presentations and analysis for the Executive Team, Board of Directors, and other key stakeholders across the organization

- Manage development and maintenance of management and investor KPI dashboard reporting

- Create reports comparing Vantage’s current capital structure and financing vehicles to peer companies and analyzing/recommending opportunities to optimize cost of capital

- Additional duties as assigned from time to time by Management

Job Requirements

- Bachelor of Science degree in Finance and / or Accounting, required

- Strong analytical mind, problem solving skills, quantitative / qualitative skillset, and modelling skills, required

- Self-starter, ability to operate independently in fast-paced environment and manage multiple tasks at once

- Demonstrates a high degree of attention to detail and an ability to complete work accurately and in a timely manner

- Executive presence and effective communication skills, required

- 3+ years investment banking experience with Debt Capital Markets (Leveraged Finance, Project Finance, Real Estate Finance, or ABS origination) experience preferred, or 4+ years of experience at a big-four accounting firm focused on debt capital markets

Additional Information:

- Travel required is expected to be up to 5-10% but may increase over time as the business evolves

Physical Demands and Special Requirements
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to handle, or feel objects; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop or kneel; talk and hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

Additional Details

- Salary Range: $135,000 - $145,000 Base + Bonus (this range is based on Colorado market data and may vary in other locations)

- This position is eligible for company benefits including but not limited to medical, dental, and vision coverage, life and AD&D, short and long-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program that includes company match, and many other additional voluntary benefits.

- Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including your qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience and may fall outside of the range shown.

We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package.
